pathways.label: If angiography is clinically justified, assess lesion significance before revascularization
supports: Intermediate lesion leaves uncertainty about functional significance
against: Invasive testing has risk and may not be needed for every stable patient
pathways.reason: Demonstrates that an intermediate angiographic narrowing should not automatically trigger stenting.

pathways.label: Stent the RCA based on visual estimate alone
against: Intermediate stenosis alone is insufficient evidence of benefit
pathways.reason: Unsafe reasoning trap: do not equate a percentage estimate with an automatic PCI indication.

public_case.risk_tier: Mild / lower-acuity teaching tier; not a calculated GRACE/TIMI score.

reference_findings.diagnosis: Stable chest pain with suspected chronic coronary syndrome; intermediate RCA lesion of uncertain functional significance. Alternative causes remain in the differential.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: Mild / lower-acuity teaching tier; not a calculated GRACE/TIMI score.

investigation_reports.ecg: No acute ischemic ST-segment change in the simulated resting ECG.
investigation_reports.serial_troponin: Serial high-sensitivity troponin values are below the fictional assay-specific 99th percentile and show no significant rise/fall.
investigation_reports.echo: Preserved LV systolic function; no definite regional wall-motion abnormality in this synthetic report.
investigation_reports.angiography: Illustrative report: right coronary artery (RCA) with an intermediate 50–60% focal mid-vessel narrowing; left main, LAD and circumflex without a high-grade stenosis in this scenario. Angiographic severity alone does not establish functional significance.

simulated_clinical_course.after_initial_tests: Learner should explain why serial biomarkers and ECG context matter.
simulated_clinical_course.after_anatomy: If the learner selects a physiology assessment, reveal a synthetic non-ischaemic result and explain that no PCI is performed in the reference pathway. If they choose automatic stenting, trigger a reasoning/safety debrief, not a procedural reward.

learning_objectives: Differentiate stable symptoms from acute coronary syndrome using the whole presentation.
Explain limits of a single ECG/troponin result.
Avoid automatic PCI for an intermediate lesion.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic content requires review and approval by a qualified interventional cardiologist before educational deployment. No values are validated clinical thresholds or instructions.
